$comment: Git repositories whose commit history must never live on one disk. A LIST, not a constant (df_3df1f108 OOS 2): the owner's recorded intent is 'just robotdojo, let's get it working 100% then i can expand if desired', which is only cheap to honour if expanding means adding a line here. `discover` walks the backed-up roots so a repository created tomorrow is picked up by the mechanism rather than by an edit (AC4(c)).

repos.label: black-belt
repos.reason: gitignored by the outer repo (code/.gitignore is '*') and .git is excluded from the bucket, so an unpushed commit here is protected by GitHub, the bucket, and the outer repo in exactly none of the three
